title: Lakshmana and others were treated by Sushena
introduction: Lakshmana and Vibhishana approach Rama and inform him that Indrajit's head has been chopped off. Rama was delighted with the news and applauds Lakshmana, by embracing him. Rama gets Lakshmana and others treated by Sushena. After the medical treatment by Suhena, Lakshmana becomes sound, active and full of joy.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्र्रिमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे एकनवतितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 91st chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
रुधिरक्लिन्नगात्रस्तु लक्ष्मणः शुभलक्षणः |
बभूव हृष्टस्तं हत्वा शक्रजेतारमाहवे
verses.iast:
rudhiraklinnagātrastu lakṣmaṇaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ |
babhūva hṛṣṭastaṃ hatvā śakrajetāramāhave
verses.translation: Lakshmana, endowed with auspicious bodily marks, whose limbs were drenched in blood, felt rejoiced on having killed Indrajit in combat.

glosses.meaning: and with his limbs drenched in blood

verses.devanagari:
ततः स जाम्बवन्तं च हनूमन्तं च वीर्यवान् |
संनिवर्त्य महातेजास्तांश्च सर्वान्वनौकसः
आजगाम ततः शीघ्रं यत्र सुग्रीवराघवौ |
विभीषणमवष्टभ्य हनूमन्तं च लक्ष्मणः
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa jāmbavantaṃ ca hanūmantaṃ ca vīryavān |
saṃnivartya mahātejāstāṃśca sarvānvanaukasaḥ
ājagāma tataḥ śīghraṃ yatra sugrīvarāghavau |
vibhīṣaṇamavaṣṭabhya hanūmantaṃ ca lakṣmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Having offered salutation to Jambavan, Hanuma and all those monkeys, that valiant Lakshmana of great brilliance then quickly came from there to the place where Sugreeva and Rama were there, by leaning himself upon vibhishana and Hanuma.

glosses.meaning: to the place where Sugreeva and Rama were there

verses.devanagari:
ततो राममभिक्रम्य सौमित्रिरभिवाद्य च |
तस्थौ भ्रातृसमीपस्थः शक्रस्येन्द्रानुजो यथा
verses.iast:
tato rāmamabhikramya saumitrirabhivādya ca |
tasthau bhrātṛsamīpasthaḥ śakrasyendrānujo yathā
verses.translation: Having offered his salutation and approached Rama, Lakshmana stood beside his brother, even as Lord Vamana (the younger brother of Indra) would stand beside Indra the lord of celestials.

glosses.meaning: in the vicinity of his brother
even as Lord Vamana (the younger brothre of Indra)

verses.devanagari:
निष्ठनन्निव चागत्य राघवाय महात्मने |
आचचक्षे तदा वीरो घोरमिन्द्रजितो वधम्
verses.iast:
niṣṭhananniva cāgatya rāghavāya mahātmane |
ācacakṣe tadā vīro ghoramindrajito vadham
verses.translation: Then, the valiant Lakshmana, arriving at the great-souled Rama, told him in a murmering tone (as he was feeling tiresome) about the terrific destroyal of Indrajit.

verses.devanagari:
रावणस्तु शिरश्छिन्नं लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना |
न्यवेदयत रामाय तदा हृष्टो विभीषणः
verses.iast:
rāvaṇastu śiraśchinnaṃ lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā |
nyavedayata rāmāya tadā hṛṣṭo vibhīṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Then, the rejoiced Vibhishana informed (in a clear tone) to Rama that Indrajit's head had been chopped off by the great-souled Lakshaman.

verses.devanagari:
श्रुत्वैव तु महावीर्यो लक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिद्वधम् |
प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह
verses.iast:
śrutvaiva tu mahāvīryo lakṣmaṇenendrajidvadham |
praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha
verses.translation: Just on hearing the news about the killing of Indrajit by Lakshmana, Rama of great prowess obtained immesurable joy and spoke the following words

verses.devanagari:
साधु लक्ष्मण तुष्टोऽस्मि कर्म चासुकरं कृतम् |
रावणेर्हि विनाशेन जितमित्युपधारय
verses.iast:
sādhu lakṣmaṇa tuṣṭo'smi karma cāsukaraṃ kṛtam |
rāvaṇerhi vināśena jitamityupadhāraya
verses.translation: "O Lakshmana! Well done! I feel gratified. An ardous act has been done. Consider it as our victory, through the destroyal of Indrajit.

verses.devanagari:
स तं शिरस्युपाघ्राय लक्ष्मणं कीर्तिवर्धनम् |
लज्जमानं बलात्स्नेहादङ्कमारोप्य वीर्यवान्
उपवेश्य तमुत्सङ्गे परिष्वज्यावपीडितम् |
भ्रातरं लक्ष्मणं स्निग्धं पुनः पुनरुदैक्षत
verses.iast:
sa taṃ śirasyupāghrāya lakṣmaṇaṃ kīrtivardhanam |
lajjamānaṃ balātsnehādaṇ^kamāropya vīryavān
upaveśya tamutsañge pariṣvajyāvapīḍitam |
bhrātaraṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ snigdhaṃ punaḥ punarudaikṣata
verses.translation: Smelling the head of that Lakshmana, who had augmented his fame and yet who was feeling abashed (to hear himself being praised), forcibly drawing him to his lap and placing that Lakshmana his younger brother in his lap with affection, wounded as he was, that valiant Rama, having embraced him, tenderly gazed upon him affectionately again and again.

glosses.meaning: and yet who was feeling abashed (to hear himself being praised)

verses.devanagari:
शल्यसंपीडितं शस्तं निःश्वसन्तं तु लक्ष्मणम् |
रामस्तु दुःखसंतप्तं तं तु निःश्वासपीडितम्
मूर्ध्नि चैनमुपाघ्राय भूयः संस्पृश्य च त्वरन् |
उवाच लक्ष्मणं वाक्यमाश्वास्य पुरुषर्षभः
verses.iast:
śalyasampīḍitaṃ śastaṃ niḥśvasantaṃ tu lakṣmaṇam |
rāmastu duḥkhasantaptaṃ taṃ tu niḥśvāsapīḍitam
mūrdhni cainamupāghrāya bhūyaḥ saṃspṛśya ca tvaran |
uvāca lakṣmaṇaṃ vākyamāśvāsya puruṣarṣabhaḥ
verses.translation: Smelling once more the head of that Lakshmana, who was feeling tormented by the arrows that had penetrted into his body, who had been wounded, who was breathing heard, who was endowed with auspicious characterestics, was afflicted with agony and was feeling paine dat the time of respiration, and hurriedly stroking him as well as restoring confidence in him, Rama the foremost among men spoke the following words:

glosses.meaning: who was feeling tormented by the arrows that had penetrated into his body
who was endowed with auspicious characterestics
and was feeling pained at the time of respiration

verses.devanagari:
कृतं परमकल्याणं कर्म दुष्करकारिणा |
अद्य मन्ये हते पुत्रे रावणम् निहतं युधि
verses.iast:
kṛtaṃ paramakalyāṇaṃ karma duṣkarakāriṇā |
adya manye hate putre rāvaṇam nihataṃ yudhi
verses.translation: "An extremely noble act was performed by you, a doer of difficult things. Now, that his son having been killed, I account Ravana to have been killed in battle."

verses.devanagari:
अद्याहं विजया शत्रौ हते तस्मिन् दुरात्मनि |
रावणस्य नृशंसस्य दिष्ट्या वीर त्वया रणे
चिन्नो हि दक्षिणो बाहुः स हि तस्य व्यपाश्रयः |
विभीषणहनूमद्भ्यां कृतं कर्म महद्रणे
verses.iast:
adyāhaṃ vijayā śatrau hate tasmin durātmani |
rāvaṇasya nṛśaṃsasya diṣṭyā vīra tvayā raṇe
cinno hi dakṣiṇo bāhuḥ sa hi tasya vyapāśrayaḥ |
vibhīṣaṇahanūmadbhyāṃ kṛtaṃ karma mahadraṇe
verses.translation: "As that evil-minded enenmy has been killed, I become victorious. O valiant Lakshmana! Fortunately, you indeed severed the right hand of the cruel Ravana. Indrajit is indeed the support for that Ravana. Vibhishana and Hanuma too performed a great feat in the great battle."

verses.devanagari:
अहोरात्रैस्त्रिभिर्वीरः कथंचिद्विनिपातितः |
निरमित्रः कृतोऽस्म्यद्य निर्यास्यति हि रावणः
बलव्यूहेन महता श्रुत्वा पुत्रं निपातितम् |
verses.iast:
ahorātraistribhirvīraḥ kathañcidvinipātitaḥ |
niramitraḥ kṛto'smyadya niryāsyati hi rāvaṇaḥ
balavyūhena mahatā śrutvā putraṃ nipātitam |
verses.translation: "In the course of three days and nights, the valiant Indrajit was felled down somehow. Now, I have been made free of enemies. Hearing of his son having been struck down, Ravana will indeed come forth with a great and powerful battle-array."

glosses.meaning: in the course of three days and nights

verses.devanagari:
तं पुत्रवधसन्तप्तं निर्यान्तं राक्षसाधिपम्
बलेनावृत्य महता निहनिष्यामि दुर्जयम् |
verses.iast:
taṃ putravadhasantaptaṃ niryāntaṃ rākṣasādhipam
balenāvṛtya mahatā nihaniṣyāmi durjayam |
verses.translation: "By encircling that Ravana, who is difficult to be conquered, with a great army, I will kill him, who is coming forth with a feeling of distress for the death of his son."

glosses.meaning: who is difficult to be conquered
feeling distressed of his son's killing.

verses.devanagari:
त्वया लक्ष्मण नाथेन सीता च पृथिवी च मे
न दुष्प्रापा हते त्वद्य शक्रजेतरि चाहवे |
verses.iast:
tvayā lakṣmaṇa nāthena sītā ca pṛthivī ca me
na duṣprāpā hate tvadya śakrajetari cāhave |
verses.translation: "O Lakshmana! As that Indrajit has been killed in battle by you, who are my protector, neither Seetha nor this entire earth is hard to attain."

verses.devanagari:
स तं भ्रातरमाश्वास्य पारिष्वज्य च राघवः
रामः सुषेणं मुदितः समाभाष्येदमब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
sa taṃ bhrātaramāśvāsya pāriṣvajya ca rāghavaḥ
rāmaḥ suṣeṇaṃ muditaḥ samābhāṣyedamabravīt |
verses.translation: Having thus consoled Lakshmana and having embraced him, that Rama who was born in Raghu-dynansty, was duly delighted and by calling Sushena, spoke to him the following words:

glosses.meaning: who was born in Raghu dynasty

verses.devanagari:
सशल्योऽयं महाप्राज्ञः सौमित्रिर्मित्रवत्सलः
यथा भवति सुस्वस्थस्तथा त्वं समुपाचर |
verses.iast:
saśalyo'yaṃ mahāprāGYaḥ saumitrirmitravatsalaḥ
yathā bhavati susvasthastathā tvaṃ samupācara |
verses.translation: "O highly intelligent one! You attend upon this wounded Lakshmana, who is fond of frinds, so that he will become perfectly well in health."

verses.devanagari:
विशल्यः क्रियतां क्षिप्रं सौमित्रिः सविभीषणः
कृष वानरसैन्यानां शूराणां द्रुमयोधिनाम् |
ये चान्येऽत्र च युध्यन्तः सशल्या व्रणिनस्तथा
तेऽपि सर्वे प्रयत्नेन क्रियन्तां सुखिनस्त्वया |
verses.iast:
viśalyaḥ kriyatāṃ kṣipraṃ saumitriḥ savibhīṣaṇaḥ
kṛṣa vānarasainyānāṃ śūrāṇāṃ drumayodhinām |
ye cānye'tra ca yudhyantaḥ saśalyā vraṇinastathā
te'pi sarve prayatnena kriyantāṃ sukhinastvayā |
verses.translation: Let Lakshmana along with Vibhishana be quickly made free from pain caused by the arrows that have penetrated into their body. Let all others too among the gallant bear and monkey-warriors fighting with trees who have fought on the battle-field here and stand pierced with arrows and owunded, be healed in the same way with great care."

glosses.meaning: free of pain caused by the arrows that have penetrated into their body
among the gallant bear and monkey-warrior
who have gought on the battle-field
and stand pierced with arrows and wunded

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तः स रामेण महात्मा हरियूथपः
लक्ष्मणाय ददौ नस्तः सुषेणः परमौषधम् |
verses.iast:
evamuktaḥ sa rāmeṇa mahātmā hariyūthapaḥ
lakṣmaṇāya dadau nastaḥ suṣeṇaḥ paramauṣadham |
verses.translation: As commanded by Rama, the great-souled Sushena, the monkey-cheif gave an excellent medicine through nose to Lakshmana.

verses.devanagari:
स तस्य गन्धमाघ्राय विशल्यः समपद्यत
तदा निर्वेदनश्चैव संरूढव्रण एव च |
verses.iast:
sa tasya gandhamāghrāya viśalyaḥ samapadyata
tadā nirvedanaścaiva saṃrūḍhavraṇa eva ca |
verses.translation: Inhaling the odour of that herb, Lakshmana became healed of the arrow-wounds, free from pains and his wounds got completely cured.

glosses.meaning: and his wounds got completely cured.

verses.devanagari:
विभीषण मुखानां च सुहृदां राघवाज्ञया
सर्ववानरमुख्यानां चिकित्सां स तदाकरोत् |
verses.iast:
vibhīṣaṇa mukhānāṃ ca suhṛdāṃ rāghavāGYayā
sarvavānaramukhyānāṃ cikitsāṃ sa tadākarot |
verses.translation: As per the order of Rama, Sushena then treated his companions like Vibhishana and others including all the monkey-chiefs.

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रकृतिमापन्नो हृतशल्यो गतव्यथः
सौमित्रिर्मुदितस्तत्र क्षणेन विगतज्वरः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ prakṛtimāpanno hṛtaśalyo gatavyathaḥ
saumitrirmuditastatra kṣaṇena vigatajvaraḥ |
verses.translation: Then, with his arrow-wounds healed, his fatigue gone and his feverishness cured within a moment, Lakshmana having restored his original disposition, felt joyful there.

verses.devanagari:
तथैव रामः प्लवगाधिपस्तदा |
विभीषणश्चर्क्षपतिश्च जाम्बवान् |
अवेक्ष्य सौमित्रिमरोगमुत्थितं |
मुदा ससैन्यः सुचिरं जहर्षिरे
verses.iast:
tathaiva rāmaḥ plavagādhipastadā |
vibhīṣaṇaścarkṣapatiśca jāmbavān |
avekṣya saumitrimarogamutthitaṃ |
mudā sasainyaḥ suciraṃ jaharṣire
verses.translation: Then, on seeing Lakshmana standing up with sound health, Rama, Sugreeva, Vibhishana and the valiant Jambavan along with the army were rejoiced for a long time.

verses.devanagari:
अपूजयत्कर्म स लक्ष्मणस्य |
सुदुष्करं दाशरथिर्महात्मा |
बभूव हृष्टा युधि वानरेन्द्रो |
निशम्य तं शक्रजितं निपातितम्
verses.iast:
apūjayatkarma sa lakṣmaṇasya |
suduṣkaraṃ dāśarathirmahātmā |
babhūva hṛṣṭā yudhi vānarendro |
niśamya taṃ śakrajitaṃ nipātitam
verses.translation: That great-souled Rama apllauded the ardous feat of Lakshmana. Hearing of Indrajit having been kille din battle, Sugreeva became delighted.
